verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a compliance case-management SaaS that could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only REST-style APIs (Alerts, Case, Case Import, Filing) and UI features, with no mention of any command-line tool. APIs are developer building blocks, not a CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
